notes: The multicollinearity data-generating-process block (PROC IML, randseed 12345): builds a Toeplitz correlation among the first six predictors (r={1,0.8,0.75,0.7,0.65,0.6}) inside an otherwise identity covariance, draws X ~ RandNormal(200, Mu, Varcovar), and forms Y = X*Beta + eps with the authored sparse Beta. Replication count reduced from 1000 to 100 for a fast captured run; PROC MEANS and PROC CORR summaries confirm the induced X1-X6 correlation (empirically ~0.82 for X1-X2, matching the design). Deterministic across repeated POSTs.
